## 简体中文

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.7

- 同一请求并发创建或追加批次时只执行一次，参数冲突会明确报错；参考图导入同步去重。
- 合并会将源批次移动到目标并移除源批次，保留图片版本、备份和调用历史；保存或清理中断后可恢复，并兼容旧合并请求与创建请求。
- 持久化失败后任务队列能继续运行；输出目录改用本地 UUID，隔离旧索引中的越界路径。
- 按当前兔子文档区分 Flash/Pro 同步图片与 Pro 异步/GPT-Image 2 任务，修正参考图、比例和 processing 状态；升级后的旧任务沿原协议查询，不重复提交。旧 Flash 4K 配置兼容官方基础模型与分辨率参数。
- 新兔子协议目前仅完成文档核对和离线合同测试，未进行真实 API 调用或付费验证；实体 Mac 的维护者安装流程尚未验收。
- 本次 Beta 下载产物为 macOS ARM64 安装包。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.6...v1.1.0-beta.7)

## English

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.7

- Concurrent creation or append requests with the same key execute once and reject conflicting arguments; reference imports are also deduplicated.
- Merge moves source batches into the target and removes the sources while retaining image versions, backups and call history. Interrupted persistence or cleanup can recover, including legacy merge and creation requests.
- Job queues continue after persistence failures. Output directories use local UUIDs, and unsafe paths in historic indexes are isolated.
- Current Tuzi documentation now determines Flash/Pro synchronous image and Pro async/GPT-Image 2 task protocols, reference fields, ratios and processing status. Saved tasks query their original protocol without resubmission; saved Flash 4K configurations map to the official base model and resolution parameter.
- The new Tuzi protocol has documentation review and offline contract tests only, with no real or paid API validation. Maintainer installation through the physical Mac user flow remains unverified.
- This Beta provides a macOS ARM64 installer.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.6...v1.1.0-beta.7)
